system.description:
At 3rd level, you gain proficiency in Medicine and Medicine Kits. You can make any checks using the aforementioned skill and Toolkit with Intelligence or Wisdom.

You take the teachings of your village’s medical corps, your direct master or found medical documents and blend it into your techniques. You can learn and add Jutsu with the Medical Keyword to your known jutsu list. Your unique fighting style has taught you to trigger your Lethal Attack feature against creatures with ranks of Envenomed or Corroded.

Additionally, you gain the Festering Siphonage Hunter Exploit. This does not count against your Exploit Limit.
